text_block_list.text: ...*Pant*! Damn it! Why am I so weak...!

text_block_list.text:
She thinks that giving it her all and 
still losing means she simply lacks the 
ability to win...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:

Because—there's no way I could be weak 
after receiving everyone's support!”

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:

sure, I'll run a race worthy of everyone's 
support!"
